goal: Implement Albert Hazan's 2026-10-02 owner instructions (verbatim: "assign someone to pause merges during production runs"; "if you can't then you'll have to be ok with using one reviewer twice"). A: for review slot >= 2 on a MERGED pull request (verified merged-PR issue binding), when no independent reviewer remains, --assign-reviewer and --replace-failed-reviewer may draw a reviewer already holding another slot on that exact head, still excluding failed, unusable, preflight-excluded, independence-conflict and retired reviewers, deterministically; assertDurableReviewApproval accepts that shared reviewer only in that merged slot>=2 case. Open PRs keep strict slot independence. B: a bounded TTL-expiring create-only promotion merge freeze ref (--acquire-promotion-freeze / --release-promotion-freeze) that --acquire-merge and repository-maintenance authorization refuse under, naming holder and expiry; preview and production are never blocked; the production job's always() cleanup releases the freeze for its source PR. Ruling recorded in docs/owner-rulings.md and standing fact 14. Generation 2 answers governed review round 2 (qwen REVISE H1): the merge/promotion approval gate scripts/check-exact-head-approval.mjs enforces the same slot-independence invariant and must accept the shared reviewer only when the pull request is merged at the exact head; plus unreadable-freeze, CLI and workflow-step test pins and doc clarifications.
prohibited_actions: No migration file and no database structure change
No weakening of slot independence for open pull requests
The freeze never blocks preview or production lanes
No branch-protection change, no forged or hand-edited review artifacts or refs
assumptions: Merged state for reviewer reuse is proven by the existing mergedPrReviewTarget hook installed by SHARED_DB_MERGED_PR_ISSUE_BINDING / withMergedPrIssueBinding
Generation 2 edits were drafted in the uncommitted worktree before this contract was published; no generation-2 implementation commit exists before publication
stop_conditions: Stop if any required check fails at the implementation head
Stop on a coordination-mutex, contract or guarded-lane refusal that cannot be resolved with evidence
